A1_verdict.alignment_theorem: If WGP2's transmission axis coincides with the detector axis, d^T J_WGP2(phi2) == t_perp2(nu) * d^T IDENTICALLY (J2 diagonal in that basis) -> a REAL WGP2 is mathematically indistinguishable from an IDEAL analyser times the scalar t_perp2(nu), for ANY E_in/theta/geometry. Verified to 4.4e-16 over 9 (psi,delta) combos; non-vacuous (10deg misalignment -> 6.1e-3 deviation).
A1_verdict.numbers: two-WGP vs one-WGP at identical params: -0.0094 dB at BOTH theta=0 and theta=90 (angle-independent, max|delta|=0.018 dB). Deficit direction: required extinction U(90)/U(0)=6.01e-5 (D_eff=4.683) vs 4.51e-3 (D_phys=11) -> data need the shadow 18.75 dB DEEPER, while misalignment scan (delta,psi<=20deg) only makes it SHALLOWER (up to +8.07 dB); 0/49 combos reach the target.
A1_verdict.owner_q3_answered: T10: bright throughput at theta=0 is 0.939 (WGP2 transmission axis || d) vs 0.00423 (wires || d), ratio 4.5e-3. Measured |T(0deg)| is O(1) -> 'wires along d' is EXCLUDED by the data; WGP2 sits axis-along-d, i.e. exactly in the theorem's premise.
A1_verdict.consequence: The D_eff puzzle (0.43-0.64, physical pin dAIC +6000..+9000) is NOT the missing WGP2 and still needs another explanation. The only channel through which WGP2 can matter is MISALIGNMENT phi2 != d — which is the physical 1-parameter version of the phenomenological eps_cross, and is what A2/A3 now test on data.

tasks.desc: OWNER PRIORITY QUESTION 2026-07-29 (out of order): is there a LINEARIZATION of Malus' law for a non-ideal polarizer with leakage? Answer + teaching note.
tasks.result: YES and it is EXACT, but the textbook 3-parameter form a0+a1cos2t+b1sin2t only holds for INTENSITY (incoherent) composition. For this project's COHERENT model (E=t_perp cos^2 + t_par sin^2, U=|E|^2) the exact linear basis is 5-dimensional: U = c0 + a2cos2t + b2sin2t + a4cos4t + b4sin4t (identity, synthetic resid rms 1.4e-16). Closed forms: |t_perp|^2=c0+c2+c4, |t_par|^2=c0-c2+c4, Re(t_perp conj(t_par))=c0-3c4 -> eta and cos(dphi) model-free; theta0=0.5*atan2(b2,a2) with ANALYTIC sigma (delta method), no multistart, no bootstrap. IDENTIFIABILITY: an angular scan at ONE frequency constrains at most 5 real numbers -> formal reason for the D_eff<->eta degeneracy. A4/A2 = 0.2498/0.2458/0.2549/0.2549 on data vs 0.25 exactly for ideal cos^4. *** KEY FOR A6: cost of ANGLES_LIMIT_2D=(0,90) measured — cond(XtX) 2.14 (full) vs 236.3 (truncated), sigma(theta0) 9.9x worse from PLAN GEOMETRY ALONE; theta0 shift full->truncated: 356att -0.687, series1 +0.351, series2 -2.103, test_grid -0.920 deg — COMPARABLE TO THE WHOLE A2 angle_offset dispute (-1.294/+0.219/+0.584). *** WEIGHTING MATTERS: unweighted LS on power weights points as U^2 -> blind to the shadow; series1 gave |t_par|^2<0. With sigma_i ~ U_i the two independent offsets (from h2 and h4) agree to 0.004-0.051 deg. Model-free theta0: +0.901+-0.184 / -0.546+-0.248 / -0.463+-0.198 / +0.599+-0.327 deg; eta 0.0127/0.0121/0.0130/0.0329 (M5 range 0.012-0.036). *** tau_leak model-free from slope of dphi(nu): 356att 0.195 ps vs M5's 0.19 ps (independent confirmation) but NOT universal (series2 -0.104 ps); reliability gated by Cauchy-Schwarz |cos dphi|<=1, violated 12/151, 43/94, 20/129, 0/147 -> OPEN QUESTION. Breaks linearity: log/dB scale, Fabry-Perot, detector nonlinearity, angle error. Does NOT break: eta(nu), phase term, Parseval summation, two-WGP structure (T8), phi2 misalignment.

DONE 2026-08-04 (chat A3). HN14 REJECTED: eps_cross is NOT a rig constant. Homogeneity test on the COMPLEX pair (Re, Im), chi2 = sum (z_i - z_bar)^T C_i^-1 (z_i - z_bar), dof = 2(N-1): full angular range 761.6/10 dof p=3.8e-157 across all 6 datasets; 677.1/6 p=5.4e-143 within the ATTENUATOR group (356att, series1-3); 45.0/2 p=1.7e-10 within the SINGLE-WGP group (specac, test_grid_40_20). Same verdict on the production (0,90) truncation: 602.7/10, 233.2/6, 23.0/2. Observed |eps| spread exceeds its own quoted error by 9.4x. *** WHY IT WANDERS — the decisive comparison: the MODEL-FREE leakage eta (A0 harmonics, closed form, independent of Blanco and Drude) is nearly CONSTANT within each group on the full range — attenuator 0.01210..0.01537 (x1.3), single-WGP 0.03290..0.03594 (x1.1), and the two groups honestly differ (0.012 vs 0.033) — while on the SAME data the M5 parameters wander: eta0 x57.4 and x24.6, |eps| x7.1 and x3.1. So the reproducible quantity is the TOTAL leakage, not its decomposition into D_eff / eta0 / eps_cross: the degeneracy is TRIPLE, not double. Consequence: eps_cross can neither be pinned as a setup constant nor quoted per sample, and it cannot break the D_eff<->eta degeneracy because it is itself part of the degenerate cluster. *** A6's LEFTOVER ITEM CLOSED (full-range M5 refit): D_eff moves by tens of percent where angles are added — 356att D/D_phys 0.678->0.373 (10->19 angles), test_grid 0.943->0.586 (11->25); eta0 moves by orders of magnitude (356att 0.04462->0.00115). The truncation even breaks the model-free estimator: eta(A0) spread over the attenuator group is x1.3 on the full range vs x3.3 truncated (series2 0.01298->0.00465). D_eff PUZZLE NOT RESOLVED: D_eff/D_phys = 0.371..0.586 across all six samples on the full range, still far from the lattice-sum value of ~1. *** METHODOLOGY — the A2 lesson needs REPHRASING: the M5_eps landscape has 3-20 DISTINCT basins per 21 starts, separated by tens-to-hundreds of AIC (sharp separated minima, not a flat valley); only 56 of 252 starts (22.2%) reach the global basin. 'Warm beats cold' is FALSE: cold wins 11 of 12 cases, but WHICH cold start wins is dataset-dependent (cold_eps0, cold_eps0.001_ph90/180, cold_eps0.01_ph0/90/270, cold_eps0.034_ph180/270, cold_D0.3/0.6/0.9*Dphys, and once warm_eps_ph0). Correct rule: use a GRID of starts; any single start is unreliable. *** RETRACTION: the published |eps_cross| = 0.0345 for 356att (A2, also in this state.json and in a_numbers_for_paper.json) belongs to the 4th-deepest basin of 11, 192.5 AIC ABOVE the global one (-22684.4 vs -22876.9). A3 reproduces it BIT-FOR-BIT from A2's seed (cold_eps0), so this is not an implementation discrepancy but insufficient multi-start in A2 -> handoff A->D to retract the number. *** PROPOSAL FOR A5: reparameterise M5 in terms of the observable total leakage eta instead of three individually unobservable parameters. *** purewave BLOCKED (see 'blocked'): no data.

tasks.result: DONE 2026-07-29, 9/9 validation. Scope fixed by handoff C->A: A4 is the PHYSICAL REFERENCE (accuracy + identifiability), attenuator_app/core is the PRODUCT calculator (reproducibility + conservative interval); no integration, crosscheck instead (C2_a4_crosscheck). Definition matches C's measurement: A = -10*lg[sum_nu|E(t1,t2,nu)|^2 / sum_nu|E(0,0,nu)|^2] (Parseval energy, normalised to the aligned config). API: attenuation_db, band_attenuation_db, attenuation_map, required_angle (inverse problem by bisection; explicit refusal + achievable max when the target is out of range). Validation includes: ideal limit = two-element Malus A = -20lg|cos(t1)cos(t1-t2)cos(t2)| (dev 3.6e-15 dB); bit-match with the A1 kernel (0.0); A(+t1)==A(-t1) IDENTICALLY - direct confirmation of the HN13 conclusion that the model has no theta-ODD term; Jensen inequality (band-energy attenuation <= weighted mean of A(nu), so 'mean attenuation over frequency' systematically overstates). *** NUMBER RELEVANT TO THE D_eff PUZZLE: at the PHYSICAL D=11 um the reference gives a limiting attenuation (theta=90) of 23.45 dB, while the model-free extinction from data (A0, eta=0.0127) is ~37.9 dB - a ~14 dB gap, i.e. the D_eff puzzle seen from the instrument side. Adding leakage eta0=0.03 DECREASES the limit (23.45 -> 21.21 dB), so leakage and reduced D_eff act in OPPOSITE directions - the D_eff<->eta degeneracy in instrument terms. Crosscheck table for C: 0.2-1.5 THz x 0-90 deg (27x19) in a4_grid_for_crosscheck.json; CRITICAL caveat recorded there: use the SAME d_um in both implementations, otherwise one compares different samples rather than different calculators.

methodology_notes: A2: angular add-on parameters in this problem are MULTIMODAL. Always warm-start nested variants from their submodel's optimum and run at least two starts (misalignment basin vs eps_cross basin); a cold start made phi2 look 16-sigma significant when the deeper basin puts it at 1.6+-4.8 (insignificant).

A3 SUPERSEDES the reading of the A2 note above: 'warm beats cold' is FALSE as a rule. Measured on M5_eps over 6 datasets x 2 angular ranges: 3-20 distinct basins per 21 starts, only 56/252 starts (22.2%) reach the global one, and cold wins 11 of 12 cases — but WHICH cold seed wins is dataset-dependent. The correct rule is a GRID of starts (|eps| x phase, plus several D_seed values, plus warm), then take the deepest basin and RECORD the gap. A2's own headline |eps_cross|=0.0345 came from the 4th-deepest basin of 11, 192.5 AIC above the global one.

A3: when a fitted parameter cluster is degenerate, check it against a MODEL-FREE estimator before interpreting it physically. Here the A0 harmonic eta is stable to x1.1-1.3 within an optical-configuration group while the M5 parameters (eta0, eps_cross, D_eff) that are supposed to encode the same physics wander by factors of 25-57 on the same data. The stable quantity is what may be reported; the decomposition is not.
